question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

All the actors played their roles very well in the __________.
solution:
The correct answer is "**masque**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given sentence, the role played by the actors in some play has been discussed.**
 
• Now, among the given options, the correct word to use in the blank is "masque."
 
• **"Masque" means a type of play performed by masked actors**.(लीला-रूपक)
 
 
• Example: She enjoyed dancing and took great delight in organising masques. 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "masque" is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• - Option 1, "manse", refers to a large and imposing house, especially a country house in Scotland.(पादरियों का घर)
 
• - Option 2, "marks", could refer to grades or scores given to the actors, but it doesn't fit as well as the correct answer.(अंक)
 
• - Option 3, "mosque", is a place of worship for Muslims and has nothing to do with the context of the sentence.(मस्जिद)
